description: This Java file defines the DeleteFeaturesStrategy class, which handles the processing of the DeleteFeatures command within a persistence context for 'things'. It includes logic for extracting features from a Thing, generating events like FeaturesDeleted, and managing entity tags related to feature deletions.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for handling DeleteFeatures commands, facilitating feature removal from Things and generating corresponding events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete features command, generating a result with the updated event or an error if features are not found.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Extracts the Features object from a Given Thing, or throws if not present.

methods.name: getEventToPersist
methods.description: Creates a FeaturesDeleted event for persistence, based on context and metadata.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Generates the response headers for the delete features command, including optional ETag headers.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the previous entity state related to the delete command, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag after delete operation; here it is always empty, indicating no specific tag.
